name: record-template
title: Record
description: Structure for a single record: status, actions and section tabs in the header, then main content and a summary column.
docs: A template from MACAW 0.2.2. Components come from @macaw-ds/ui and stay on the upgrade path; this composition is yours to edit.

block.name: Record
block.purpose: Structure for a single record: status, actions and section tabs in the header, then main content and a summary column.
block.description: A PageHeader with meta (status Badge), actions and a TabNav whose tabs are URLs, then an 8 + 4 split on the layout grid: the active tab's content in the main column and a summary Card with a definition list in the side column. Exports RecordSummary for the side column. Renders the main area only.
whenToUse: One invoice, customer, payout or subscription with sections the user can link to.
A record with a short set of key facts that should stay visible next to the details.
whenNotToUse: Switching panels in place without changing the URL: that is a Tabs component, not TabNav.
Editing many settings: use the settings template.
rules: Render inside AppShell's main; never add a second main or a TopBar.
The PageHeader title is the page's only h1; card titles are h2.
Every tab is a link to its own URL with active set on the current one.
At most one primary Button, in the PageHeader actions.
The summary column is col-span-4 and the main column col-span-8.
